items.title: Biogen (NASDAQ:BIIB) Reports Upbeat Q2 CY2026
items.summary: Biotech company Biogen (NASDAQ:BIIB) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 3.4% year on year to $2.74 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.60 per share was 75.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Biogen Q2 revenue, adjusted EPS beat estimates as growth portfolio lifts sales
items.summary: Investing.com -- Biogen reported second-quarter revenue and adjusted profit above analysts’ estimates on Wednesday, helped by 24% growth in its Growth Portfolio and stronger revenue from recently acquired products, although sales of its Alzheimer’s drug Leqembi narrowly missed expectations.
